spanish: Tu derecha, Jehová, gloriosa en la fuerza; tu derecha, Jehová, quebrará a enemigo.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3fs does not mark future time; «quebrará» selects futuro. Feminine subject, person, and qal stem stay.

notes: Repetition of tu derecha and Jehová, the niphal as gloriosa, en la fuerza with the article, and anarthrous singular enemigo stay inside the tokens.
